name: Dau Go Cave
kicker: The second room on the same landing
summary: You walk the cave the port calls one of the earliest known on the bay, on the same đảo Đầu Gỗ landing as Thiên Cung. The port says Hồ Chí Minh visited. Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, this cave, and Ba Hang together. A minute in this room alone was not printed.
getThere: Route 1 boat, same landing as Thien Cung
heroCaption: A shaft of light in the cave

notice.title: Same boat as Thien Cung
notice.body: The port pairs Đầu Gỗ with Thiên Cung on route 1, a 3–4 hour loop that also includes Ba Hang. A minute in this cave alone was not printed.

body: This is the second room on the đảo Đầu Gỗ landing. The port calls it one of the earliest known caves on the bay, and a place Hồ Chí Minh visited. You are still inside the 3–4 hour route.
Ba Hang comes after, on the water, not as another walking chamber. A gate hour for Đầu Gỗ alone was not printed. Check on arrival. No separate cave price was opened.

figures.caption: The cave interior
figures.alt: Interior of Dau Go Cave in Ha Long Bay

gettingThere: Route 1 from Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long, with Thiên Cung. The English port line is Beach road, New Beach, Bai Chay ward. The route clock is 3–4 hours for the three stops together.

legs.heading: From the Ha Long port
legs.body: The route-1 boat. A minute in this cave alone was not printed. Check on arrival.

hours: Check on arrival. A gate hour for this cave alone was not printed.
closed: No weekly closing day was printed. Confirm the sailing the day you go.
admissionNote: No separate price. Route 1 on the 15 March 2024 page is 440,000–460,000 đồng, split on that page as 310,000 sightseeing and 150,000 boat. The child bands differ between that page (7 to 15) and the 17 July 2023 board notice (7 to under 16). Both stay. From 10 December 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport.
